banner.title: envoy-gateway
banner.tagline: Runs the Envoy Gateway controller and the two Envoy fleets, envoy-external and envoy-internal, that serve every HTTPRoute in the cluster.

art.about: one controller pushing config to two gateway fleets
art.title: How envoy-gateway serves every route

explainer.title: One controller, two front doors, every route

steps.title: Class
steps.text: GatewayClass envoy points at the EnvoyProxy envoy, which runs the proxies in the network namespace.

steps.title: Gateway
steps.text: envoy-external and envoy-internal each open a plain HTTP listener for the redirect and an HTTPS listener on the wildcard Secret.
steps.scene: two gateway arches side by side

steps.title: Route
steps.text: HTTPRoutes from any namespace attach to the HTTPS listeners. The HTTP listeners take only the same-namespace redirect.

steps.title: Proxy
steps.text: The controller pushes config to each Envoy pod over xDS. On shutdown a pod drains for up to 180 seconds before it exits.
steps.scene: a stream of light entering a proxy box

facts.label: on both Gateways, with HTTP/2 and 1.1
